title: Wave smoothing uniform in the coefficients
source_hypothesis: Smooth scalar spatial second-order family on a half-space, positive real symmetric principal matrix, constant spatial principal matrix at the reference parameter face, arbitrary smooth complex lower terms, zero Dirichlet values, both Cauchy jets supported in metric radius 2/5, and uniform extendible-distribution bounds for every parameter derivative. Solutions are smooth for positive parameter-normal coordinate and |t|<3. Conclusion: every mixed derivative is uniformly bounded for 1<=t<=2 and metric radius 2/5 on one fixed parameter neighborhood; all spatial dimensions n>=1 are included.
